displayName: Set Temp Folders to Local Path
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Redirects the TEMP, TMP, and INetCache paths to the local drive

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\SetTempToLocalPath
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = No Action, 1 = Redirect TEMP and TMP to Local Disk, 2 = Redirect INetCache to Local Disk, 3 = Redirect TEMP, TMP, INetCache to Local Disk
